newsitem.title: GERMANY: DG Bank not in talks to sell stake in BHF.
newsitem.headline: DG Bank not in talks to sell stake in BHF.

text.p: German cooperative bank Deutsche Genossenschaftsbank, which owns a stake of 9.6 percent in BHF-Bank AG, said on Friday it was not in talks about selling its stake to Bankgesellschaft Berlin and had not been approached.
But DG Bank also said it did not regard its stake in BHF-Bank as a strategic investment.

"We are not in talks with Bankgesellschaft and we have not been approached," a DG Bank spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry. "But we have also stressed that the stake is not a strategic investment."
German newspaper Boersen-Zeitung said on Friday that Berlin-based bank Bankgesellschaft was interested in acquiring a majority stake in Frankfurt-based bank BHF-Bank.
The newspaper said that Bankgesellschaft was considering taking a 75 percent stake in BHF Bank and that key discussions about the issue were underway.
Bankgesellschaft responded on Friday that it was not in talks with BHF-Bank or its owners.
BHF-Bank is 15.17 percent-owned by insurer Allianz AG Holding, which said on Friday it did not plan to sell its stake.
